name: @aoelite/refpact-ts
description: Architecture tests for TypeScript 6 and 7: rules about what files may import, checked as ordinary tests.

scripts.build: cargo xtask wasm && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:ts6: cargo xtask wasm && REFPACT_TYPESCRIPT=typescript-6 vitest run
scripts.test:ts71: cargo xtask wasm && REFPACT_TYPESCRIPT=typescript-71 vitest run
